We will also review the charge-off date of December 6, 2023, and the last payment date of April 16, 2025. Our investigation will determine the accuracy of the debt and whether it is indeed yours.

You have the right to dispute this debt and request that we cease collection efforts if the debt is found to be inaccurate. We will notify you of the results of our investigation and provide you with the necessary information to resolve this matter.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.
